en.title: [Inha University Center for Culture & Arts Education] Recruitment of Dedicated Staff for School Arts Instructor Support Project
summary: Inha University Center for Culture & Arts Education is recruiting 1 dedicated staff member for the 2026 School Arts Instructor Support Project.
Main duties include managing operating schools and instructors, with a contract period from October 1, 2026, to January 31, 2027.
The salary is 2.65 million KRW/month (before tax) for a 40-hour, 5-day work week.
Preference is given to Excel certification holders, Culture and Arts Educator license holders, and those with relevant project experience.
Applicants must submit the resume form via email (inhaarte@inha.ac.kr) by September 27, 2026.
en.easyExplanation: Inha University Center for Culture & Arts Education (문화예술교육원) is recruiting one full-time staff member to manage the School Arts Instructor Support Project. Preference is given to applicants with Excel certifications, Culture and Arts Educator (문화예술교육사) licenses, or related experience. Interested candidates must submit their resume by email by September 27, 2026.
en.target: Preferred qualifications: Excel certification holders and proficient users, Culture and Arts Educator (문화예술교육사) license holders, those with experience in similar projects (understanding of school sites and arts instructors), those with strong responsibility and communication skills, and those with an easy commute.

- 사업명: 2026 학교예술강사 지원사업

- 업무: 2026 학교예술강사 지원사업 운영학교 및 강사 관리 등
- 근무형태 : 주5일 40시간(*4대 보험 가입)

- 근무장소: 인하대학교 문화예술교육원(5호관(남)432B호)
- 우대사항
1. 엑셀 자격증 소지자 및 활용 가능자

* 보내실곳: inhaarte@inha.ac.kr
